title: Corner Resize Updates All Participating Windows
description: ui: resizing on corners must work for all participating windows and preview all directions. e.g. cad has four windows that share a corner but when I move only the right two change height and the left two are not changing height correctly. Fix so a shared + junction corner drag resizes every participating axis (main + all peer cross axes) live in all directions.
summary:
Shared + junction corner drags only updated one cross-axis (e.g. right column heights), so a CAD 2×2 left pair stayed wrong while the live preview only moved two windows.

Fix: resolveJoinCornerPeerCrossAxes walks the main separator’s perpendicular children and returns every join at the dragged cross-axis fraction. applyModeJoinCornerResize and Mode.onJoinCornerResize apply the cross delta to all peers (live setLayout + persisted sizes) so width and both column heights update together. Cross-separator corner alongFraction now sits on the parent-facing edge (0/1) instead of mid-pane.

Verified: 5 focused vitest cases pass (peer resolution, pure apply, Mode pointer drag updating both columns, cross-separator placement).
